# Cleanroom consumables

**Cleanroom is one of the specialty verticals in our growth plan. The material available here does not confirm which cleanroom products we stock today, so please check the current catalog or ask your account representative before ordering.**

## What our plan says

- Our growth plan lists cleanroom alongside cannabis testing, cold chain and forensics as specialty verticals (Thomas Scientific growth plan).
- The thesis is to move from a distributor to a lab supply-chain company. Specialty verticals sit next to punchout ordering, vendor-managed inventory (VMI) and private label (Thomas Scientific growth plan).
- In the month-36 scenario, a West Coast cleanroom or life-science tuck-in brings us to 11 distribution centers (Thomas Scientific growth plan). That is an assumption, not a forecast.

## How cleanroom fits the timeline

| Milestone | Cleanroom-related step | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Month 12 | No acquisitions while the refinancing is open | Plan assumption |
| Month 24 | Midwest/Texas tuck-in, ~$20M revenue (est.) | Not cleanroom-specific |
| Month 36 | West Coast cleanroom or life-science tuck-in, ~$15M revenue (est.) | Plan assumption |

- Our first-lien loan matures on Dec 14, 2027. Every growth step is sequenced behind liquidity and refinancing (Thomas Scientific growth plan).
- A dedicated cleanroom acquisition would therefore come after the refinancing, not before.

## What we cannot confirm yet

- **Current product range.** We do not know the cleanroom SKUs in stock today, such as gloves, wipes, garments or swabs. The live catalog and SKU master would show this.
- **Revenue share.** We do not know what share of revenue cleanroom represents now. Sales by product category would show this.
- **Customer demand.** We do not know how many of our scored sites buy cleanroom products. The demand map scores 27,503 lab, pathology and hospital sites, with 713 rated Pursue and 2,317 Nurture. It does not flag cleanroom demand in what is shown here (Thomas Scientific growth plan).

Cleanroom is one of the higher-value specialty lines that help us earn a valuation above a commodity distributor. A credible specialty story is part of what earns the refinancing ahead of the December 2027 maturity.

## Next actions

1. Pull the current cleanroom SKU list and trailing-twelve-month sales by category. Confirm what we supply today.
2. Tag Pursue and Nurture sites in the demand map for cleanroom purchasing. Size the vertical before any tuck-in work.
3. Check which cleanroom lines could move to private label. That would support margin from mix.
4. Keep any cleanroom acquisition screen behind the refinancing timeline.
